title: OTHRYS OS Mnemosyne Intelligence
goal: Make existing Mnemosyne recall more current, conflict-aware, relationship-aware and context-efficient without adding a second memory authority or new storage technology.

work.problem: Mnemosyne already preserves and searches explicit knowledge, but context capsules do not yet explain source currentness/divergence strongly enough and use coarse per-section limits rather than an explicit context budget.
out_of_scope: No embeddings, vector database or LLM reranker
No new Greek memory subsystem or second knowledge authority
No autonomous promotion, canon mutation or research loop
No destructive cleanup of historical estate evidence
risks: Derived currentness is mistaken for authority
Historical evidence is suppressed instead of labeled
Conflict detection produces noisy false certainty
Context budgeting hides required project truth

laws: Project-local declared truth and House Books outrank historical estate evidence.
Currentness and conflict are derived warnings, never authority or automatic deletion.
Historical evidence remains retrievable with provenance even when superseded.
Context selection must explain why each item was selected and respect a bounded budget.
Atlas remains a derived read model; Mnemosyne remains the knowledge authority.

tasks.title: Expose one-hop relation kinds and deterministic ranking reasons
Prove historical evidence remains visible, conflicts stay warnings and authority stays false
